name: ARM Cortex-M4 Real-Time OS
description: Custom real-time operating system designed for ARM Cortex-M4 microcontrollers with priority-based scheduling.
longDescription: A lightweight, deterministic real-time operating system built from scratch for ARM Cortex-M4 processors. Features include preemptive multitasking, inter-task communication, memory management, and low-latency interrupt handling optimized for embedded applications.

name: RISC-V Pipelined Processor
description: 5-stage pipelined RISC-V processor implementation with hazard detection and branch prediction.
longDescription: Complete implementation of a 5-stage pipelined RISC-V processor supporting RV32I instruction set. Includes advanced features like data forwarding, hazard detection units, branch prediction, and cache memory subsystem for enhanced performance.

name: IoT Sensor Network Platform
description: Distributed sensor network system with mesh topology for industrial monitoring applications.
longDescription: Scalable IoT platform for industrial sensor networks featuring mesh networking, edge computing capabilities, and real-time data analytics. Designed for harsh industrial environments with fault tolerance and self-healing network topology.

name: FPGA-based Signal Processor
description: High-performance digital signal processing unit implemented on FPGA for real-time audio applications.
longDescription: FPGA-based digital signal processing system optimized for real-time audio processing. Implements various DSP algorithms including FFT, FIR/IIR filters, and adaptive algorithms with hardware-accelerated parallel processing capabilities.

name: Embedded Machine Learning Engine
description: Lightweight machine learning inference engine for resource-constrained embedded systems.
longDescription: Optimized ML inference engine designed for microcontrollers with limited memory and processing power. Supports neural network quantization, model compression, and efficient inference algorithms for edge AI applications.

name: USB Protocol Analyzer
description: Hardware-based USB protocol analyzer for debugging and reverse engineering USB communications.
longDescription: Custom USB protocol analyzer built with FPGA and high-speed ADCs for capturing and analyzing USB traffic. Provides real-time packet decoding, protocol violation detection, and timing analysis for USB development and debugging.

name: Motor Control System
description: Advanced motor control system with field-oriented control for high-efficiency electric motor drives.
longDescription: Sophisticated motor control system implementing field-oriented control (FOC) algorithms for three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motors. Features sensorless operation, adaptive control, and high-frequency PWM generation for industrial applications.

name: Cache Memory Simulator
description: Comprehensive cache memory simulator for analyzing cache performance and optimization strategies.
longDescription: Educational and research tool for cache memory analysis supporting various cache architectures including direct-mapped, set-associative, and fully associative caches. Includes replacement policies, write strategies, and performance metrics visualization.
